title: PolarPlane
author: DeepBuild
description: PolarPlane as circle@1 rings every radius_step out to radius_max, azimuth_step path rays from the center, and each ray's angle as text@1 in the math role past the outer ring, in the azimuth units. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

radius_max.about: the outer ring's radius in units

size.about: the plane's width in units; 0 for 2 × radius_max

azimuth_step.about: the rays: how many divide the turn; 0 for the units' own (12 in degrees and gradians, 24 in pi, 12 in tau)

azimuth_units.about: how ray angles read: pi or tau fractions, degrees or gradians

azimuth_offset.about: the first ray's angle in radians, counterclockwise from +x

azimuth_label_buff.about: the gap from the outer ring to each angle, in units (SMALL_BUFF)

azimuth_label_font_size.about: the angles' font size: an em of it ÷ 96 units

add_coordinates.about: whether each ray shows its angle

color.about: the rings' and rays' color; unwritten, the muted role

stroke_width.about: the lines' width, w × unit ÷ 100 u

params.d: polyline(cx, cy, cx + cos(t) * rmax * unit, cy + ys * sin(t) * rmax * unit)

params.text: azimuth_units == degrees ? cat(shown(i * per / steps, 0), deg_sign) : (azimuth_units == gradians ? cat(shown(i * per / steps, 0), grad_sign) : (i == 0 ? shown(0, 0) : (whole ? cat(i * per / steps == 1 ? blank : shown(i * per / steps, 0), azimuth_units == pi ? pi_sign : tau_sign) : cat(p / g == 1 ? blank : shown(p / g, 0), azimuth_units == pi ? pi_sign : tau_sign, slash, shown(steps / g, 0)))))

onto: cy + ys * sin(t) * (rmax + azimuth_label_buff + azimuth_label_font_size / 96 * 0.6) * unit

refuses.radius_config: Leave it out: the rings take color and stroke_width.
refuses.faded_line_style: Leave it out: the polar plane draws no faded lines.
refuses.faded_line_ratio: Leave it out: the polar plane draws no faded lines.
refuses.make_smooth_after_applying_functions: Leave it out: rings are circles, smooth at any size.
refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
